y audience for the videos includes: • Food and beverage manufacturers • Nutrition and health product manufacturers • Research and development teams • Technical experts and researchers • Industry opinion leaders and influencers • Existing and prospective customers of Irish dairy ingredient suppliers The videos will primarily be used in the campaign's target markets of China, Vietnam and Singapore. Campaign-Wide Direction for All Videos The three videos should sit within the established EU Dairy Ingredients campaign world: premium, technical, international, credible and B2B-focused. The sports nutrition video can be used as a broad reference for format and production language — expert-led storytelling, product/application footage, lab/R and D environments, ingredient close-ups and motion graphics — but agencies should be encouraged to propose their own creative treatment for each topic. The work should avoid heavy consumer advertising cues and should not create or imply unverified health, nutrition, medical or infant-related claims. Instead, the films should focus on quality, functionality, technical capability, science-backed innovation, trusted European supply and partnership with manufacturers.
